column1: Rules keyed on the customer's TackQuote buyer group code, read from TackQuote when it is needed and kept for 60 seconds per customer. The customer's email address (and, where TackQuote supports it, the Magento customer ID) is sent to TackQuote to find the account. Rules use group CODES (for example GOLD), compared without regard to case. @GUESTS means everybody outside a group: guests, customers TackQuote places in no group, and customers outside the groups selected below. The admin and integrations (TackQuote's own quote conversion included) are never affected.
